name: Kyle Hill
source: Picture the most charismatic and attractive guy that ever graced the earth. Now let him keep the self-assurance and attitude but without the charisma and attractiveness: that's pretty much Kyle Hill. But he's got something going for him right? Well, he's rich, if that helps.
